digest.component_or_area: CI/CD workflow and pytest test routing
propositions: 19 inventoried repository-policy AST/text assertions execute redundantly across all four default-suite matrix cells (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.13) despite having identical OS/Python-invariant inputs and expected results
The shared workflow sends an identical default selector to all four matrix cells even though repository-policy nodes require execution only once in Ubuntu 3.13
Mixed-module inspection rules out whole-file routing because the same files contain platform-specific runtime, subprocess, filesystem, and Git behavior that must remain on macOS

Adding a new Ubuntu shard would duplicate checkout, install, collection, and session fixtures and consume additional runner resources, so routing through the existing Ubuntu 3.13 cell adds zero runner or fixture cost

The proposed fix applies a strict repo_policy pytest marker to exactly the 19 function-level nodes, keeps them in Ubuntu 3.13 default selection, and appends `and not repo_policy` only in the other three default selections without adding jobs or sessions
